question_text: Students at a university were surveyed as to whether they wanted a new library for the university. Out of the 100 students surveyed, 40% said they wanted a new library. What is justifiable based on this information?
options: Of the 100 students surveyed, 40 wanted a new library.
40% of all people in the university community want a new library.
Exactly 40 students at the university want a new library.
No more than 40 university students want a new library.
